recolor_path_safe.instructions: Do COSpriteManager::loadResAnim / CO::loadResAnim still get a valid base image when the base sprite is lazily loaded (load is triggered before recoloring)?

criteria.true: Recoloring triggers the lazy load first.
criteria.false: Recoloring may run on an unloaded image.
